"""Publish numerical/attribution evidence only, preserving private media."""
import argparse
import collections
import html
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

from core import colab_artifacts as a

root = Path.cwd()
f = root / '.benchmark/png-bmp-native-expansion-20261023'
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('snapshot')
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.snapshot.isdigit()
folder = f / 'inspection-snapshots' / args.snapshot
inspection = a.document(folder / 'inspection.json')
review = a.document(folder / 'visual-review.json')
assert review['inspection_sha256'] == a.digest(a.read(folder / 'inspection.json', a.MIB))
approved = set(review['accepted_ids'])
checked = {r['id']: r for r in inspection['checks'] if r['id'] in approved}
baseline = {r['id']: r for r in a.document(f / 'baseline.json')['originals']}
old = {r['id']: r for r in a.document(root / 'benchmarks/png-bmp-native-reviewed-20261023.json')['sources']}
verifications = [a.document(p) for p in sorted((f / 'prepared').glob('*/verification.json'))]
prepared_ids = {r['id'] for v in verifications for r in v['originals']}
assert approved == prepared_ids
prepared = []
for path in sorted((f / 'prepared').glob('*/media/prepared.json')):
    prepared.extend(a.document(path)['artifacts'])
assert len(prepared) == 4 * len(checked)
assert {r['role'] for r in prepared} == {'unassigned'}
originals = []
for identity, c in checked.items():
    row = old[identity] if identity in baseline else a.document(f / 'intents' / (identity + '.json'))['source']
    if identity in baseline:
        title = row['page'].split('/wiki/', 1)[1]
        credit, attribution = '', row['author']
    else:
        page = a.document(f / 'evidence' / (identity + '.json'))
        assert a.digest(a.read(f / 'evidence' / (identity + '.json'), a.MIB)) == row['evidence_sha256']
        title = page['title']
        ext = page['imageinfo'][0]['extmetadata']
        text = lambda name: html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>', '', ext.get(name, {}).get('value', ''))).strip()
        credit, attribution = text('Credit'), text('Attribution') or row['author']
    originals.append({**c, 'title': title, 'page': row['page'], 'original_url': row['original_url'],
                      'license': row['license'], 'license_url': row['license_url'], 'credit': credit,
                      'attribution': attribution, 'page_revision': row['page_revision'], 'evidence_sha256': row['evidence_sha256'],
                      'reused_baseline': identity in baseline, 'capture_history_verified': False})
results = [a.document(p) for p in sorted((f / 'requests').glob('*.result.json'))]
intents = [a.document(p) for p in sorted((f / 'intents').glob('*.json'))]
reservations = {p.parent.name: a.document(p) for p in sorted((f / 'requests').glob('*/reservation.json'))}
result_ids = {r['id'] for r in results}
new_debit = sum(v['reserved_transfer_bytes'] for v in reservations.values())
assert new_debit <= 512*a.MIB
counts = dict(collections.Counter(r['native_mode'] for r in originals))
mode_groups = {mode: len({r['group'] for r in originals if r['native_mode'] == mode}) for mode in ('L', 'RGB')}
assert max(collections.Counter((r['group'], r['native_mode']) for r in originals).values()) <= 8
metadata = [a.document(p) for p in sorted(f.glob('query-*.receipt.json'))]
summary = {'schema': 'spatial-native-expansion-snapshot-v1', 'snapshot': args.snapshot,
           'status': 'ready_prepared_subset_only', 'originals': originals, 'prepared_artifacts': prepared,
           'native_modes': counts, 'mode_groups': mode_groups, 'author_groups': len({r['group'] for r in originals}),
           'inventory_targets': {'L': 128, 'RGB': 128}, 'missing_to_inventory_target': {m:128-counts.get(m,0) for m in ('L','RGB')},
           'training_ready': False, 'visual_holds': review.get('held_ids', {}), 'visual_rejections': review.get('rejection_reasons', {}), 'representative_benchmark': False, 'cover_cleanliness_verified': False,
           'common_ancestry_absence_proven': False, 'roles': 'unassigned', 'optimizer_updates': 0, 'new_gpu_attempts': 0,
           'prepared_image_bytes': sum(v['output_bytes'] for v in verifications),
           'independent_payload_checks': sum(v['independent_payload_checks'] for v in verifications),
           'artifact_hashes_verified': sum(v['artifact_hashes_verified'] for v in verifications),
           'pairwise_similarity_comparisons': inspection['pairwise_comparisons'], 'similarity_flags': inspection['similarity_flags'],
           'raw_original_bytes_in_prepared_subset': sum(v['bytes'] for v in originals),
           'collection': {'source_results': results, 'status_counts': dict(collections.Counter(v['status'] for v in results)),
                          'in_flight_ids': [v['source']['id'] for v in intents if v['source']['id'] not in result_ids],
                          'preliminary_unreviewed_ids': [v['id'] for v in results if v['status']=='quality_passed_pending_visual_review' and v['id'] not in checked],
                          'old_reserved_debit_bytes': 55307394, 'new_reserved_debit_bytes': new_debit,
                          'known_combined_reserved_debit_bytes': 55307394+new_debit, 'historical_total_bytes': None,
                          'new_max_transfer_bytes': 512*a.MIB, 'failed_source_retries': 0},
           'metadata': {'requests': len(list(f.glob('query-*.reservation.json'))), 'response_bytes': sum(v['bytes'] for v in metadata)},
           'source_bindings': {'publisher': a.digest(a.read(Path(__file__),a.MIB)), 'protocol': a.digest(a.read(root/'benchmarks/png-bmp-native-expansion-protocol-20261023.json',a.MIB)),
                               'paced_schedule': a.digest(a.read(f/'paced-schedule-contract.json',a.MIB)),
                               'inspection': a.digest(a.read(folder/'inspection.json',a.MIB)),
                               'visual_review': a.digest(a.read(folder/'visual-review.json',a.MIB)),
                               'readable_tools': a.digest(a.read(root/'benchmarks/png-bmp-native-expansion-tools-20261023.json',a.MIB))}}
assert summary['prepared_image_bytes'] <= 256*a.MIB
path = root / ('benchmarks/png-bmp-native-expansion-snapshot-'+args.snapshot+'-20261023.json')
a.put(path, a.encode(summary), 4*a.MIB)
print(path.name, 'originals', len(originals), 'counts', counts, 'artifacts', len(prepared), 'payload checks', summary['independent_payload_checks'])
